layers.message: Record context, scope, and design for invoice discounts

graderOnly: WorkflowState TESTING is owned by Tester; Developer owns no workflow work in this state.

The discovery helper (node .standards/bin/invocation.mjs developer --client claude --json) reports the AUTONOMOUS, CODE_WITH_ME, and STEPWISE collaboration modes with STEPWISE saved in the development plan, a complete developer user-style inventory of alice and tony, and tony saved with User Style Locked true.
A correct help-only run changes no file, does not run check.mjs or npm test, does not read the contents of alice.md or tony.md, and suggests neither switching to alice nor clearing the style.

all.why: examples use Claude Code invocation syntax
no Codex syntax for a Claude Code run
a locked style gets no change or clear suggestion

invariants.why: a help-only request never changes git state
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the project's existing tests pass on the committed implementation
the persisted TESTING state and cycle records are valid

selfChecks.cmd: set -f; out=$(node .standards/bin/invocation.mjs developer --client claude --json); for w in AUTONOMOUS CODE_WITH_ME STEPWISE alice tony; do echo $out | grep -q $w || { echo missing $w; exit 1; }; done
selfChecks.why: the discovery helper is available and reports the three collaboration modes and both user styles
the style inventory contains exactly the alice and tony files

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): small Node ESM invoicing library (src/totals.js, src/format.js, test/totals.test.js with 3 passing node:test tests). 10-styles: user-owned developer styles alice.md and tony.md under .standards/user-styles/developer/. 20-upstream: Auditor context, scope (AC-001..AC-003), and design for cycle add-invoice-discounts-20260922T141500Z-3c9e5a71, with STATE at DEVELOPING. 30-implementation: discount implementation in src/, the development plan (Mode STEPWISE, User Style tony, User Style Locked true, Status COMPLETE, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION/NONE, DEV-001 and DEV-002 DONE with self-check evidence), and STATE at TESTING after a FORWARD handoff from DEVELOPING in a STANDARD FULL_DELIVERABLE cycle. No verification report exists yet (Tester has not started), which check accepts at TESTING. Utterance is 'help' so the invocation is '/developer help'. The run-the-helper part of assertion 0 and the no-check/no-tests part of assertion 2 have no predicate, so the judge reads the trace.
